correctness.rationale: The metric is inversion count on S_4, equal to graph shortest-path distance on the adjacent-swap Cayley graph with 24 vertices and 36 edges. The audited two standard-library programs enumerate every clique and reduce exact F_2 boundary matrices; K_2 has face vector (24,96,112,30), K_3 (24,168,472,618,384,92) and K_4 (24,228,1112,3042,4848,4592,2592,822,112). Independently implemented BFS/clique enumeration and exact boundary reduction reproduced all K_4 face counts and ranks (0,23,205,907,2135,2708,1882,710,112,0), while cycle-image elimination reproduced 39 Z_2(K_2) generators, rank B_2(K_3)=326 and rank(B_2(K_3)+image Z_2(K_2))=327, so the critical map H_2(K_2)->H_2(K_3) has rank one. This gives eight bars [2,3) and one [2,4), not merely the Betti numbers; ranks of all other degrees give 13 H_1[1,2), five H_4[4,5) and two H_5[4,5). Each vertex has one distance-six antipode, giving K_5=(S^0)^{*12}=S^11 and K_6 a full simplex. Full finite enumeration certifies this one metric; not a theorem about S_n for all n or integral coefficients.
